text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the designation of an accessible loading zone on the east side of Lynnhaven Road, south of Rondale Boulevard. The accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curbside access to TTC Wheel-Trans service for a resident of Lynnhaven Road.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible loading zone to operate at all times on the east side of Lynnhaven Road, between a point 97 metres south of Rondale Boulevard and a point 9 metres further south. 2. Rescinded the maximum one-hour parking limit, in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily, on the east side of Lynnhaven Road, between a point 97 metres south of Rondale Boulevard and a point 9 metres further south.
